_opening_ramp: Tier C (#307): whole-round opening multiplier; neutral tier-1 ramp preserves #293 pacing. HP captures at spawn; ordinary damage at impact; bosses capture both on arrival.
_tier: Tier A: map IDs and original_life from v83 Map.wz. Tier C (owner, spec #253): region, map order, boss picks and pool rules; the numeric curve (keyframe rate/max_alive/hp/speed, bursts, elites, exp_mult, hard_cap, post_duration_slope) copies Henesys exactly. The 210 s keyframe is Henesys's curve interpolated at 3:30 (rate 0.875, max_alive 17.5, speed 1.0375), added only to carry the 3:30 pool change; keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).
name: West Street Corner of Perion
_bosses: Tier C (spec #253, starting values, untuned): each boss matches the Henesys boss of the same map slot (Mano, Mushmom, Blue Mushmom) at that slot's typical_hp/typical_pdd: survivor HP = round(canonical maxHP x hp_mult) equals the slot's, and hp_mult/dmg_mult/attack_dmg_mult are the 0.01 steps whose 85-100% roll range (CombatMath.monster_damage) lies closest to the slot's touch/attack roll range. Canonical PDD/MDD, level and undead flags are not normalized.
